a0_repin_policy.reason: Crop pixels are compatible, but A0 mount pins are a coherent whole-file set and its current host keeps Hero under Entities; cross-parent foot-sorting remains an A0 native gate.

discrepancy_resolution.cause: A0 compared first_hour_visual_payload_lock payload_subset_sha256 values against whole compiled presentation file_sha256 values. Those are different hash domains; the lock source_commit ad39bde6 identifies the frozen payload/crop baseline, not the current global atlas file.

hash_definitions.file_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact committed file bytes (PNG compression/JSON formatting included).
hash_definitions.payload_subset_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({ground,overlays,props,lights,capture_views,ambient_day,ambient_night}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")). This is NOT a whole .presentation.v1.json file hash.
hash_definitions.raw_rgba_sha256: SHA-256 of decoded crop pixels converted to RGBA8, row-major, width*height*4 bytes. No PNG header/compression. Rect is [x,y,w,h] from the atlas manifest.
